question: Shovana Narayan is associated with which classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak. **__

__**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​**Shovana Narayan **is a Indian **Kathak dancer and a career officer **with the Indian Audit and Accounts Service.
 
• She represent kathak in India and internationally, and has been **awarded the Padma Shri.**
 
• The starting of Kathak is normally attributed to the traveling bards in of early northern India known as **Kathakars or storytellers.**
 
• **The **mesmerizing, precise, and pulsating footwork, also the graceful yet detailed carriage of the upper body, hand placements, and facial expressions,** demonstrate Kathak's diverse cultural effects.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information​__**

 
• **Sattriya** is a dance-drama performance art with beginning in the** Krishna-centered Vaishnavism monasteries of Assam** and attributed to the 15th-century Bhakti movement scholar and **saint Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev.**
 
• **Mohiniyattam**, is an Indian traditional dance form that established and remained **popular in the state of Kerala.**
 
• **Bharatanatyam **is **a classical dance of Tamil Nadu in southern India**.
